seekVerification.method: sha256 of a 320x180 downscale of the canvas, taken in-page at the probe beat, at the locked beat, and again after a hold at the locked beat. Within-run change detection only — the digests are renderer-specific and are not a cross-machine baseline.

note: opening-film-4 exposes no drawn-geometry data structure (nodes/edges/labels) on window, so this capture records the PNG and the canvas backing size only. Capture hooks as observed in the page: __filmSeek=function, __filmElapsed=number, __filmFreeze=undefined before this script set it (the film reads that flag in its rAF tick and never defines it; typeof after setting it: boolean). The seek and the freeze were verified by frame digest — see seekVerification.
